response.text: {"question":"As of 05 January 2025, how often must the Internal Ombudsman report to the Board committee handling customer service and protection, and what is required if the regulated entity rejects the Ombudsman’s decision?","answer":"The Internal Ombudsman must provide reports at least every six months, preferably quarterly, and any rejection of the Ombudsman’s decision must be approved by the Competent Authority.","answerable":true}
